cover_letter_text:
Hi Coffey Testing team,

I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to start out as a materials testing technician. Your advert says new starters learn alongside experienced technicians, in the lab and on site, so I wanted to apply.

On site in the Philippines in 2019 and 2020, I carried out inspections and quality checks and kept the material records, working closely with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. Later, in the diploma, I worked with AS 1289 and AS 1726.

I live in Melton with my own car and a driver's licence, have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), and can start two weeks after an offer. Glad to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
